axes.name: bitmap_index
axes.rationale: Target's SBB/AND/ADD index sequence selects bitmap word 0 when flag 4 is set and word 1 otherwise; these source forms test whether C7 lowers that exact boolean differently.

spec.semantic_summary: Test the target-derived subtract/decrement type dispatch with a byte local and compare equivalent flag-to-bitmap index forms; object code deduplication will collapse equivalent C7 outputs.
